signal: Trackforce Valiant secured over $150M from K1 and now serves 300,000+ professionals across 30,000 sites in 45 countries

email.body1:
Jeff, saw Trackforce Valiant's $150M from K1 and the scale to 300,000-plus professionals across 30,000 sites.

Scale like that usually means more co-sell and partner targets in play than the team can cover at the same depth, and that is where partner-sourced pipeline plateaus. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously across a partner ecosystem, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a signal play for Valiant's partner ecosystem off hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress ~4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?

Jeff, quick follow-up for Valiant.

Most BD teams have more strong partner targets than time to personalize outreach to each, so co-sell motions stall before they start, no matter how good the partnership thesis is.

I had our AI SDR draft three personalized emails to your top partner targets. Want to hop on a quick call and I'll walk you through them, plus how the same engine keeps every partner thread warm?
email.body3:
Jeff, last bit of proof for Valiant.

Memgraph had more accounts in play than the team could touch and couldn't hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how your partner-sourced reply rate likely compares to similar B2B teams. Want to hop on a quick call and I'll walk you through it?
email.body4:
Jeff, I'll stop reaching out on this one, but didn't want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling partner-sourced pipeline without adding headcount isn't a priority this quarter, no problem at all. Timing matters, and standing up co-sell at this scale keeps a BD team busy.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page co-sell pilot playbook of three AI-SDR plays for your partner ecosystem? I'll tailor it to Valiant either way.
